_about: Owner phrases about CHE's own version, build or install. The phone (lib/self_update/che_self_update_intent.dart cheIsAppStatusRequest) must attach its native build report to every 'runtime' and 'receipt' phrase, or the Worker answers 'installed version unavailable'. The Worker (server/cloudflare/self_update.js appStatusIntent) must route every 'runtime' phrase to che_runtime_status, and neither side may claim a 'neither' phrase. Read by test/che_app_status_test.dart and server/cloudflare/version_truth.test.mjs.
